api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your qk_ API key from Settings → API Keys. Requires the data:read and data:write scopes.

org_id.title: Organization ID
org_id.description: Your Querri organization ID (from Settings → Account).

base_url.title: API Base URL
base_url.description: Querri API base URL. Change only for a dedicated or self-hosted Querri. Must use https; plain http is accepted only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and host.docker.internal (local testing).

source_name_prefix.title: Source Name Prefix
source_name_prefix.description: Prefix added to stream names when creating new Querri sources. E.g., 'airbyte_' turns stream 'users' into source 'airbyte_users'.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Rows per append request (append streams). Overwrite streams send up to 100,000 rows per request regardless. Higher values mean fewer requests and more memory.
